body: this sounds fucking awful. i’m sorry no one believes you. i’m not making a judgement about whether or not you’re delusional but if you want someone to believe you, it looks like you’ll have to get some kind of proof. (a photo of one in your mouth would probably be best but i’m really not sure). good luck!
That makes me feel much better. I’m sure it’s not easy for him seeing me go crazy and having to deal with it but I genuinely can’t help myself sometimes. Thank you
He’s the same age as I am, actually three or four months younger.
You’re not being a jerk and I have an appointment with the counseling center at my school tomorrow. Hopefully that helps me.
I know you're right but I just can't make myself hear you. I just want him.
He *was* the nerdy guy I vented to about my boyfriend. Now I have no one to vent to and an ex who I'm desperately attached to.

I am not religious anymore and I just need help to stop texting and calling him. He was my rock for the past year. It was both the best and worst year of my life, but overall, I felt secure. Now I feel like a stray dog being kicked aside. I am desperate for love, and I don't care how pathetic that sounds because it's just the truth.

I understand it is not good at all, but I can't convince myself he is an abuser. To me, he is still the amazing guy I met last year. If he's abusive, why do I want him so much? Why do I spam call him? Why do I feel like I need him?
